title: Stationers' Register Online
institution: Giles Bergel (Oxford), Ian Gadd (Bath Spa) with James Cummings and Pip Willcox; supported by CREATe, University of Glasgow
notes: Database of the copy-entries (permissions to print) recorded in the Stationers' Company Register, 1554-1640, from Arber's transcript corrected against the Register's images, with original spelling, cancelled text, marginalia and Arber's notes, and indexes of stationers and titles. Counts are ours, from the full TEI XML delivered by the site's /api/allEntries service: 10,453 entries and about 418,000 words of entry text. The sibling series by Eyre and Rivington (1640-1708) is described by the project but was not found in the data. The site works as of October 2026; the web application dates from about 2018 and no dated update was found, so the status 'active' is a cautious reading.
